title: Public procurement evidence, five budget levels, short tabs, and NVHBM
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's interactive approval: implement the proposed public procurement/specification register, evidence-separated cost estimation, and five numeric budget levels; also shorten category tab labels and add NVHBM research. Publish these changes as provisional public-source views. Do not treat publication approval as Consensus, a calibrated price model, or procurement/adoption authority. Preserve missing specifications, costs, and product dates as gaps.
